The general statement is unchanged and remains the only primary.

phi=l^(-1), J_(X,Y)=a_(X,Y,-)^(-1), and the entire parenthesized module data are retained. The order id_X tensor a_(Y,-,-) composed with a_(X,Y tensor -,-) matches the original. Final references to2.39,2.23,2.25,2.26,2.10and2.13 match.
